name: aws-lc-rs v1.19.0
body:
## What's Changed

* Add AES OFB, CFB8, and CFB1 modes by @lokeswarivejju in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1259
  * Adds `OperatingMode::OFB`, `OperatingMode::CFB8`, and `OperatingMode::CFB1` for AES-128, AES-192, and AES-256 through both the one-shot and streaming cipher APIs.
* Add an on-demand AWS-LC self-test API by @Elvrarin in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1262
  * Adds `aws_lc_rs::try_fips_self_test()`, allowing applications to re-run all AWS-LC cryptographic algorithm self-tests without calling the sys crate through unsafe FFI. This does not re-run the module integrity test.
* Add  Keccak-256 digest support behind *"unstable"* feature flag by @fabrice102 in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1266
  * Adds `aws_lc_rs::unstable::digest::KECCAK256` and `KECCAK256_OUTPUT_LEN` behind the `unstable` feature for use with the existing `digest::digest` and `digest::Context` APIs.
* Add configurable RSA-PSS salt lengths by @PaulDance in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1267
  * Adds `RsaPssSaltLength::{Digest, Max, Custom}` and `with_pss_salt_length` builders on `RsaSignatureEncoding` and `RsaParameters`, covering signing and verification for both message and precomputed-digest APIs.
* Implement `Clone` for signing key pairs by @JakeHuneau in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1277
  * `rsa::KeyPair`, `EcdsaKeyPair`, `Ed25519KeyPair`, and `PqdsaKeyPair` can now be cloned directly rather than wrapped in an `Arc`.
  * Clones share the immutable, reference-counted `EVP_PKEY`; key material is not duplicated, and a clone remains usable after the original is dropped.

### Upstream AWS-LC

* `aws-lc-sys` v0.47.0 aligns with [AWS-LC v5.12.0](https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/releases/tag/v5.12.0) (previously v5.11.0).
* `aws-lc-fips-sys` v0.14.4 updates its bundled AWS-LC FIPS 4.2.0 snapshot with recent FIPS 4.x backports. 

### Build Improvements

* Lower the minimum system-installed AWS-LC version to 4.2.0 by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1268
  * The default `aws-lc-sys` system-library path now accepts AWS-LC 4.2.0 or newer, previously 5.7.0, allowing use of a FIPS 4.x system library.
  * Enabling the `unstable` feature requires AWS-LC 5.7.0 or newer because unstable APIs currently include Keccak-256. Bundled-source builds are unaffected.
* Share `cc` compiler detection across builds by @johncarmack1984 in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1273
  * Reuses compiler detection results across the main library build and compiler feature probes, reducing repeated compiler invocations during cold builds.

### Issues Being Closed

* Implement `Clone` for `rsa::KeyPair` -- https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/issues/1260
* Expose AWS-LC FIPS on-demand self-test -- https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/issues/1261
* Add a way to specify the RSA-PSS salt length -- https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/issues/1263

## Other Merged PRs

* build(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 8.0.1 to 8.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1264
* build(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1265
* fix: satisfy Clippy deprecated-since lint and lint legacy-des in CI by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1269
* ci: keep upstream Cargo.lock in rustls integration by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1270
* ci: use dynamic musl CRT for ARM FIPS tests by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1271
* Prepare aws-lc-fips-sys v0.14.4 by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1275
* Prepare aws-lc-sys v0.47.0 by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1274
* Prepare aws-lc-rs v1.19.0 by @justsmth in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1278

## New Contributors

* @lokeswarivejju made their first contribution in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1259
* @johncarmack1984 made their first contribution in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1273
* @JakeHuneau made their first contribution in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1277
* @PaulDance made their first contribution in https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs/pull/1267
